# @llazyemail/template-runtime-display API

Package: `@llazyemail/template-runtime-display`.
Node 24+. Named exports only. No default export. No runtime dependencies.
Import the package root. Builds: ESM `dist/index.js`, CJS `dist/index.cjs`, browser IIFE `dist/index.global.js` (global `TemplateRuntimeDisplay`), types `dist/index.d.ts`.

Same props always return the same string. Omitted optional strings become `''`. Rendered HTML does not contain the word `undefined`. Prop values are concatenated as HTML with no escape step.

## document(props?: DocumentProps): string

`DocumentProps` is `BodyProps` plus `headHtml`.

```ts
document({
  headHtml: head({ title: 'Hi', preview: 'peek' }),
  mainHtml: main({ heading: 'Hi', bodyText: 'Body', ctaLabel: 'Go', ctaUrl: 'https://example.com' }),
  footerHtml: footer({ companyName: 'Acme', unsubscribeUrl: 'https://example.com/u' }),
});
```

Shape:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
{headHtml}
<body>
{mainHtml}
{footerHtml}
</body>
</html>
```

`lang` is fixed to `en`. `document()` with no props is a shell: doctype, html, empty head slot, empty body.

## head(props?: HeadProps): string

| Prop | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `title` | empty `<title></title>` |
| `preview` | empty hidden div |

Always emits `<meta charset="utf-8">`, the viewport meta, `<title>`, and `<div style="display:none;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;">`.

## main(props?: MainProps): string

| Prop | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `heading` | empty `<h1>` |
| `bodyText` | empty `<p>`. May contain inline HTML |
| `ctaLabel` | button omitted unless `ctaUrl` is set too |
| `ctaUrl` | button omitted unless `ctaLabel` is set too |

The button is one `<a>` with inline styles. Either prop alone leaves the anchor out.

## footer(props?: FooterProps): string

| Prop | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `companyName` | empty `<p>` |
| `unsubscribeUrl` | no unsubscribe link |

When `unsubscribeUrl` is set, the link text is `Unsubscribe`.

## body(props?: BodyProps): string

| Prop | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `mainHtml` | empty string inside `<body>` |
| `footerHtml` | empty string inside `<body>` |

## content(props?: ContentProps): string

| Prop | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `content` | empty `<div>` |

`content` is raw HTML placed in the div. Callers insert the result where they want it. `document` does not call `content` or `main` itself.
